description.zh: 环境实体。您指定的可写字段将被更新，未指定的字段将保持不变
description.en: The environment object. This operation updates only the specified writable fields. Unspecified fields remain unchanged.

descriptions.zh:
- 使用修改（Update）的接口时，您指定的可写字段将被更新，未指定的字段将保持不变

- 当且仅当模板参数（spec.templateConfig.parameters）发生变化时，才会触发自动部署
descriptions.en:
- This operation updates only the specified writable fields. Unspecified fields remain unchanged.

- This operation triggers an automatic deployment only if the template parameters (spec.templateConfig.parameters) change.
